name: cork-mcp
description: Every Cork API operation, plus cross-client risk attribution, exploitability-first vulnerability triage, overdue-compliance detection, and stale-connector health checks that a stateless API mirror cannot answer in a single call.

cork_api_key.title: CORK_API_KEY
cork_api_key.description: Sets CORK_API_KEY for the Cork MCP server.

cork_base_url.title: Cork API base URL
cork_base_url.description: Base URL for the Cork API. Leave the prefilled default unless your account uses a different regional or self-hosted host.

cork_user_agent.title: User-Agent header
cork_user_agent.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on Cork requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's own built-in User-Agent.

printing_press_client_profile.title: Client profile
printing_press_client_profile.description: Binds this MCP server to one tenant-gated client profile, so every call answers for that customer. Leave blank to use the profile configured as default_client_profile.

cork_mcp_read_only.title: Read-only MCP mode
cork_mcp_read_only.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to expose only read-only tools and refuse any non-GET execute call. Preset to 1; clear it only when you want the agent to run the tools this switch hides.

cork_no_local_data.title: Run without a local copy
cork_no_local_data.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: reads go to the API, the response cache is off, and sync refuses to run. Leave blank to keep the local store.

cork_mcp_http_token.title: MCP HTTP transport bearer token
cork_mcp_http_token.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote/hosted deployment). Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.
